IC1: Age [OR] ≥ 18 years (Age [AND] ≥ 12 years for patients with bone sarcomas).
IC2: Histologically [AND] confirmed diagnosis of unresectable [OR], recurrent [OR], and/or metastatic [OR] high grade soft-tissue [OR] or bone sarcoma of one of the following subtypes: soft tissue sarcomas [OR] (leiomyosarcoma, poorly differentiated [OR]/de-differentiated liposarcoma, high grade pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma [OR]/MFH and synovial sarcoma), and bone sarcomas (Ewing sarcoma [OR], osteosarcoma [OR], and chondrosarcoma [de-differentiated [OR] or mesenchymal]).
IC4: At least one site of measurable disease [AND] on CT [OR]/MRI scans as defined by RECIST 1.1. Baseline imaging must be performed within 30 days of dosing.
IC5: At least one site of accessible disease for pre- and post-treatment core biopsies for at least 20 patients per arm on the expansion cohorts.
IC6: Patients may have received 1-3 prior systemic therapies in the metastatic setting.
IC7: Adequate organ function within 14 days of dosing
IC8: Must be willing to provide and have available archival tissue for PD-L1 testing.
IC10: Fertile men [OR] and women of childbearing potential [AND] must agree to use an effective method of birth control from providing signed consent and for 120 days after last study drug administration. Women of childbearing potential include pre-menopausal women and women within the first 2 years of the onset of menopause. Women of childbearing potential [AND] must have a negative pregnancy test ≤ 72 hours prior to Day 1 of study.
IC11: Effective methods of birth control include: surgically sterile [OR], barrier device [OR] (condom [OR], diaphragm), contraceptive coil [OR], intrauterine device (IUD) [OR], and abstinence.
IC13: Patients with central nervous system disease are eligible for enrollment if they have received prior radiotherapy [OR] or surgery [AND] to sites of CNS metastatic disease and are [NOT] without evidence of clinical progression for at least 4 weeks prior to screening, have [NOT] no evidence of new [OR] or enlarging brain metastases, and are [NOT] off steroids for at least 7 days before first dose of pembrolizumab [AND].
